title: reviewModuleTask
responsibility: Record one verdict per module-task attempt, verify acceptance evidence, preserve work before requeueing incomplete work, and return a previously recorded verdict on replay.

inputs.name: reviewModuleTask.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to worktree checkpointing and module-task analytics sync. It is used when an incomplete review needs a checkpoint and after the repository update.

inputs.name: reviewModuleTask.repository
inputs.description: The module-task repository read to find the task and updated with the review result. It must provide read() with data.tasks and update(callback, checkpoint) returning the commit and callback value.

inputs.name: reviewModuleTask.id
inputs.description: The task identifier matched against task.id in the initial read and again during the update. It must identify the same task in both queue snapshots.

inputs.name: reviewModuleTask.input
inputs.description: Review payload with a claim UUID and verdict. Acceptance requires verification evidence carrying the submission. An incomplete verdict requires feedback and preserves a checkpoint before requeueing.

examples.feedback: Add scenario proof for the changed behavior.

inputs.unknownReason: The submission review payload is checked at runtime before the queue is updated.

outputs.name: reviewModuleTask
outputs.type: Promise<{ commit: string | undefined; task: ModuleTask; replayed: boolean }>
outputs.description: Returns the queue commit and task after recording a verdict, with replayed false. An equivalent replay returns the current queue commit and existing task with replayed true.

errors.name: TaskNotAwaitingAttemptReviewError
errors.description: The task, matching claim, or submitted result is missing, or the task is outside review.

errors.name: StaleTaskReviewError
errors.description: The task status, claim, contract, or result changed before the review could be saved.

errors.name: Invalid checkpoint or verification evidence
errors.description: The submission has to name a checkpoint with changed files. The cited commit must carry those files unchanged and have an intact verification record covering the module. Git lookup failures can also reject.

errors.name: Conflicting review verdict
errors.description: Resending the recorded verdict is idempotent. An existing review for the same attempt with a different verdict is refused.
